Commerce:TenantBilling._comment: TB-INT-01 / TB-INT-02 / TB-INT-03 — entitlement publisher to canonical Tenant Billing service. Disabled by default; supply env vars Commerce__TenantBilling__Enabled / __BaseUrl / __InternalToken to activate. Never commit real tokens here. RetryAttempts/CircuitBreaker*/AutoPublishQueueCapacity are clamped at runtime by TenantBillingClientOptions.Normalised. AutoPublishEnabled gates the lifecycle-triggered auto-publish path and is independent from Enabled (publisher disabled + autopublish enabled = worker drains queue + each call returns Skipped).

Identity._comment: LS-INT-01 — LegalSynq platform identity integration. Enabled=false preserves standalone behavior. Set Enabled=true and supply SigningKey via COMMERCE_LEGALSYNQ_SIGNING_KEY env var (must match Jwt__SigningKey in LegalSynq Identity service) to activate JWT authentication. HostPlatformKey is written into HostIdentityContext and used as the externalRef lookup key in BillingAccountExternalRef.
